jobs_results.title: Senior Azure Python Developer - Backend Architecture
jobs_results.job_title: Senior Azure Python Developer - Backend Architecture
jobs_results.description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Azure Python Developer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications and middleware services on Microsoft Azure. The role will involve building Python-based REST APIs and microservices, working with PostgreSQL, containerizing applications using Docker, deploying workloads on Kubernetes/AKS, and implementing robust CI/CD and monitoring practices.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and maintain Python-based middleware, backend services, and microservices on Azure.

- Build scalable and secure RESTful APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent.

- Design and implement efficient data access and integration solutions using PostgreSQL.

- Develop modular, reusable, and maintainable microservices following cloud-native architecture principles.

- Containerize applications using Docker and deploy and manage workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

- Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, deployment, and release management.

- Monitor application performance, infrastructure health, logs, and operational metrics and proactively address issues.

- Troubleshoot application, API, database, deployment, integration, and infrastructure issues and perform root-cause analysis.

- Optimize application performance, API latency, resource utilization, and database queries.

- Implement secure coding practices, authentication/authorization, secrets management, and appropriate API security controls.

- Collaborate with DevOps, cloud, architecture, QA, and product teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

- Participate in code reviews and establish development, testing, and engineering best practices.

- Use AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, debugging, and developer productivity where appropriate.

- Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, runbooks, and operational standards.

Required Skills & Experience:

- 8 - 10 years of experience in software development, backend engineering, or cloud application development.

- Strong hands-on expertise in Python.

- Strong experience developing REST APIs and microservices.

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native application development.

- Strong experience with PostgreSQL and relational database concepts.

- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and deployment practices.

- Experience with application monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support.

- Strong understanding of secure application development and cloud security practices.

- Experience working with FastAPI, Flask, or similar Python frameworks.

- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

- Good communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Ability to independently own technical deliverables and work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment.

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Developer – Python & Azure
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer with strong Python and Microsoft Azure expertise to join our engineering team building and scaling a PCI DSS v4.0-ready, microservices-based order processing platform. This platform running on a secure, private-network Azure architecture.


You will work across the full stack - from API design and serverless compute to database design and CI/CD - building secure, cost-efficient, and highly available services in a regulated, payment-adjacent environment.


What You'll Work On

Design, build, and maintain Python-based microservices on Azure Functions (Python 3.11/3.12) across domains such as order intake, customer management, catalog, orchestration, tax, payment/PCI, fulfillment, notifications, and support APIs.
Build and secure APIs exposed through Azure API Management (APIM) - including authentication, throttling, CORS, brand-scoped RBAC, and correlation-ID based tracing.
Work within a Private VNet architecture, integrating Function Apps, Private Endpoints, NSGs, and NAT Gateway-based outbound connectivity to third-party partners (payment gateways, tax providers, OMS, email/mail services).
Design and maintain schemas in a shared Azure SQL Database using module-owned table prefixes, optimizing for cost and performance at moderate transaction volume.
Implement secrets and credential management via Azure Key Vault using Managed Identity - ensuring no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the platform.
Build tokenized payment integrations (e.g., CyberSource/PayPal) ensuring PAN/CVV data never touches application code or storage - token-only handling.
Contribute to PCI DSS v4.0 compliance controls: network segmentation, encryption in transit/at rest, access logging, audit trails, and secure system design.
Support queue- and timer-triggered async processing (cron/orchestration patterns) for order lifecycle management with retry logic.
Collaborate on cost-optimization decisions - right-sizing Function plans (Elastic Premium), SQL tiers, and reserved capacity planning.
Monitor and troubleshoot production systems using Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Partner with stakeholders to translate deployment architecture and solution design into working, well-tested code.

Requirements
What We're Looking For
Required:

6-9 years of professional software development experience, with strong full-stack capability.
Deep hands-on experience with Python (3.x) for backend/microservice development.
Solid experience building and deploying on Microsoft Azure, specifically:
Azure Functions (serverless compute, VNet integration)
Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
Experience with relational database design (schema design, query optimization, TDE/encryption-at-rest concepts).
Understanding of secure application design: secrets management, least-privilege access, RBAC, TLS/encryption in transit.
Familiarity with asynchronous/queue-based or timer-based processing patterns.
Experience integrating with third-party APIs (payment gateways, tax engines, OMS, email/notification providers, etc.).
Working knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Application Insights, Log Analytics or equivalent).
Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment practices.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

Experience working in a PCI DSS-regulated environment.
Exposure to e-commerce order management systems (Shopify, OMS platforms, or similar).
Experience with tokenized payment processing (CyberSource, PayPal, Stripe, or similar gateways).
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform on Azure).
Front-end development experience (React/Angular/Vue) for full-stack contributions beyond APIs.
Experience with cost optimization on cloud platforms (reserved capacity, right-sizing).
Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-204, AZ-400, AZ-305) are a plus.

Soft Skills

Strong ownership mindset - comfortable working across the stack from database to API to deployment.
Ability to work in a security- and compliance-conscious environment with attention to detail.
Clear communicator, able to work with architects and cross-functional stakeholders.
Comfortable in a fast-paced environment balancing scalability, security, and cost.

Outsourcing is not just a method of gaining a one-time cost advantage, but an effective strategy for gaining and maintaining competitive advantages when executed as part of an overall sourcing strategy.

NTT DATA''s Client is seeking a Python Developer with strong experience in designing, developing, and deploying cloud-based applications on Microsoft Azure. The resource should have hands-on experience in Python development, API development, data processing, cloud integrations, and working with Azure services in an enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications, services, and APIs.
• Build and deploy scalable solutions using Azure cloud services.
• Develop REST APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask.
• Knowledge of messaging queues such as KAFKA
• Work with Azure services such as Azure Functions, App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure Data Factory.
• Integrate applications with external systems, databases, APIs, and cloud services.
• Develop data ingestion, transformation, and processing pipelines using Python and Azure services.
• Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
• Knowledge of Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service.
• Implement authentication, authorization, logging, monitoring, and error handling.
• Collaborate with architects, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders.
• Troubleshoot production issues, optimize performance, and support deployment activities.
• Follow coding standards, security best practices, and cloud governance guidelines.

Required Skills:
• Strong hands-on experience in Python programming.
• Experience with REST API development using FastAPI, Flask
• Working knowledge of Azure cloud services.
• Experience with App Services, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and Key Vault.
• Good understanding of cloud-native application design and microservices architecture.
• Experience with SQL and relational databases.
• Ability to write clean, reusable, well-documented, and testable code.
• Understanding of authentication mechanisms such as Entra ID, OAuth, JWT, managed identities, and service principals.
• Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-204

Experience Level:
• 7+ years of overall IT experience
• 3+ years of Python development
• 2+ years of hands-on Azure experience
Education:
• Bachelor''s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Good to Have:
• Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-900.

About NTT DATA Services:

NTT DATA Services is a recognized leader in IT and business services, including cloud, data and applications, headquartered in Texas. As part of NTT DATA, a $30 billion trusted global innovator with a combined global reach of over 80 countries, we help clients transform through business and technology consulting, industry and digital solutions, applications development and management, managed edge-to-cloud infrastructure services, BPO, systems integration and global data centers. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter so that we may connect you with the appropriate team.

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for Canada-based positions. The starting pay range for this remote role is $65 to $75/hour CAD. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all Canada locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate''s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.
